agent_plan.note: This is a proposal. Nothing has been built and nothing has been connected — connect data only when you're happy with the plan.

agents.name: Revenue Optimizer
agents.remit: revenue nodes — pricing, volume, mix, and channel economics
agents.why: You said: “people walk in off the street”

agents.name: Marketing & Demand Agent
agents.remit: demand-side levers on revenue nodes — campaigns, local marketing, promotions, loyalty
agents.why: You said: “people walk in off the street”

agents.name: Cost Controller
agents.remit: cost nodes — COGS, overheads, procurement, waste

agents.name: Operations Agent
agents.remit: process nodes — throughput, cycle time, utilisation, capacity

agents.name: Staffing & Labour Agent
agents.remit: labour and input nodes — rota design, productivity, wage efficiency
agents.why: Part of how this kind of business is run, based on its shape.

threads: Marketing brings demand in; Revenue turns it into price, mix and repeat business.
Cost Controller and Staffing Agent both guard margin — procurement and waste on one side, rota and productivity on the other.
Operations keeps throughput honest, so revenue is delivered rather than forecast.
Revenue and Cost Controller share one question: grow the top line without letting unit cost drift.
Marketing promises what Operations has to deliver — capacity has to keep up with demand.
Revenue sets the target; Staffing Agent says what labour it actually takes to hit it.
Operations surfaces where work is wasted; Cost Controller prices the fix.
Marketing moves demand; Staffing Agent keeps the rota able to serve it.
Operations and Staffing Agent split the same constraint — process versus people.
Marketing spends; Cost Controller measures whether the spend earned its keep.
benefits: Every number on the dashboard gets a named owner instead of a shared shrug.
Recommendations are ranked by your measured gap against similar businesses, not generic advice.
Agents propose; you authorise. Nothing changes behind your back.
You can see the whole plan before connecting anything — and stop here if you don't like it.
examples: Revenue Optimizer: if its metrics trail the coffee_shop peer set, pricing and mix is the first lever it tests.
Marketing & Demand Agent: if its metrics trail the coffee_shop peer set, demand generation and retention is the first lever it tests.
Cost Controller: if its metrics trail the coffee_shop peer set, supplier terms and waste is the first lever it tests.
Operations Agent: if its metrics trail the coffee_shop peer set, process and capacity is the first lever it tests.
Staffing & Labour Agent: if its metrics trail the coffee_shop peer set, rota and productivity is the first lever it tests.
